reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in court of common pleas?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

% We model a single eviction case in Connecticut in the focus year.
focus_year(2021).
focus_state(connecticut).

case(eviction_case_1).
case_state(eviction_case_1, connecticut).
case_year(eviction_case_1, 2021).
case_type(eviction_case_1, eviction).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario facts are satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    focus_year(Year),
    focus_state(State),
    case(Case),
    case_state(Case, State),
    case_year(Case, Year),
    case_type(Case, eviction).

/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

% --- CT Gen Stat  47a-23a(a) (2020) ---
% "Such complaint shall be returnable to the Superior Court."
% We encode the court to which an eviction (summary process) complaint is returnable.
% Note: For this question, we treat "eviction" as the Connecticut "summary process" action.
statute_ct_47a_23a_returnable_court(connecticut, superior_court).

% Connecticut eviction actions are brought as "summary process" actions.
legal_is_summary_process_action(Case) :-
    case(Case),
    case_type(Case, eviction).

/* =========================
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

% The court where the eviction case is first heard is modeled as the "returnable" court.
% (Because 47a-23a(a) requires the complaint be returnable to the Superior Court.)
legal_first_hearing_court(Case, Court) :-
    case_state(Case, State),
    legal_is_summary_process_action(Case),
    statute_ct_47a_23a_returnable_court(State, Court).

/* =========================
   Question answering
   ========================= */

% The question asks whether eviction cases are first heard in "court of common pleas".
% Under 47a-23a(a), they are returnable to (and thus first heard in) the Superior Court.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_first_hearing_court(eviction_case_1, court_of_common_pleas),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in court of common pleas?
